Initial release of smyx-separation-anxiety-relief-analysis.

- Provides AI-powered detection of pet separation anxiety behaviors via smart camera video.
- Automatically triggers relief actions (owner's voice, treat dispenser, interactive toys) based on detected anxiety severity.
- Supports structured reporting, anxiety level quantification, and tailored comfort recommendations.
- Includes strict open-id acquisition workflow for data access and security.
- Designed for pet households and boarding centers; supports both Chinese and English users.
- Enables querying and Markdown-formatted display of historical anxiety reports from a cloud API.
